caseName: Our Lady of Guadalupe Sch. v. Morrissey-Berru
caseNameFull: OUR LADY OF GUADALUPE SCHOOL v. Agnes MORRISSEY-BERRU.

opinions.text: The motion of Virginia, et al. for leave to participate in oral argument as amicus curiae and for divided argument is denied. The motion of the Solicitor General for leave to participate in oral argument as amicus curiae and for divided argument is granted.
